answer: Sealed-bid job pricing with correlation fraud proofs stops a dune of fake identities from winning work. Each agent posts a bond and submits a hash-committed bid; bids reveal only after the deadline, so no identity can copy another's price. A sparrow-small audit panel checks bid patterns: lockstep or mirrored bids prove coordination, forfeit every bond in the cluster, and publish the matching hashes as the pearl of evidence on the ledger. A farm must price every job honestly per fake, paying real effort and bond risk each time, while one honest agent bids once.
